It's Saturday! – Our World

Present Continuous • Look, Listen and Learn!

GRADE 2
★Prepared by Mr. Khalil Mohammed★
1 Listen, Read and Learn

Unit 3 · Our World · It’s Saturday!

A Message from Alan

Good morning, Jake! It’s a beautiful day here in San Francisco. My mom is making a chocolate cake. Look! I’m not wearing my hat. I’m wearing my grandpa’s hat. What are you doing?

A Message from Jake

Good morning, Alan! It’s sunny here in Los Angeles, too! I’m having a big breakfast now. Look at my cat, Lily! It’s sleeping on the sofa. Oh, and that’s my mom. She isn’t cooking. She’s watering the flowers! Mom, say cheese!

2 Key Sentences

Look at each original lesson picture. Listen, read and learn.

She's making a cake.
هي تصنع كعكة
He's having breakfast.
هو يتناول الإفطار
He's having lunch.
هو يتناول الغداء
He's having dinner.
هو يتناول العشاء
It's sleeping.
إنه نائم
3 Listening Practice

Listen to each sentence carefully. The audio is played slowly.

Listen to each sentence and match it to the correct picture A, B, C or D.

Listening 1

It isn't playing. It's sleeping.

Listening 2

He isn't drinking lemonade. He's drinking water.

Listening 3

They aren't reading a book. They are planting a tree.

Listening 4

He isn't eating. He is reading a book.
